base.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game battle character, full-body transparent PNG.
Image 1 is the USER-APPROVED character identity, costume and weapon reference, NOT an image to overwrite. Create a separate combat sprite of exactly this adult male solar sovereign. Preserve his handsome angular adult face, pale blond long naturally flowing hair, gold eyes, luminous sun core in exposed muscular chest, sculpted black-and-gold asymmetric armor, flowing white waist cloth, armored long legs and pointed black-gold boots. One straight long glowing gold sword with the same ornate guard; keep blade a single continuous rigid straight shape from hilt to tip.
Natural adult proportions matching source, adult head size, long natural limbs, NO big-head SD, NO chibi, NO toy/doll proportions. Hair must have soft continuous fine strands, never stacked plates or separate ribbon chunks.
New readable battle pose: full body in side three-quarter view facing screen RIGHT, balanced stance with feet apart, knees slightly ready, sword held low toward screen right, both feet visible. Keep clear face, hand grips, chest and boot silhouettes. Match original refined painterly 2D semi-real fantasy style, not 3D. White cloth has two controlled flowing directions, does not bury limbs.
Retain a delicate gold sun halo immediately behind head and subdued chest/sword emission, but leave large surrounding aura and external VFX out of this character layer; those will be separately animated. Actual transparent alpha background, no checkerboard printed into pixels, no scenery, no ground plane, no shadow rectangle, no text/UI/frame/watermark. Full silhouette entirely inside canvas with generous transparent margin on every edge including sword tip. Portrait 1024x1536.
